CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.uspSoldClient @client INT
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT SUM(valoare) FROM dbo.Facturi WHERE client = @client;
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fnTVA(@v DECIMAL(18,2))
RETURNS DECIMAL(18,2)
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN @v * 0.19;
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ifClientiDupaAn(@an INT)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN (SELECT id FROM dbo.Clienti WHERE YEAR(creat) = @an);

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.tfLiniiFactura(@f INT)
RETURNS @r TABLE (id INT)
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO @r SELECT id FROM dbo.Linii WHERE factura = @f;
    RETURN;
END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.trgFacturiAudit ON dbo.Facturi
AFTER UPDATE
AS
INSERT INTO dbo.Audit (tabela, cand) VALUES ('Facturi', GETDATE());

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.uspRaportTVA
AS
SELECT c.nume, dbo.fnTVA(f.valoare) AS tva
FROM dbo.vwClientiActivi AS c
JOIN dbo.Facturi AS f ON f.client = c.id;
